availableToolSchemas.description: Find native app controls by domain and query. Paginated descriptors identify availability, resource ownership and reversal; unavailable commands explain the missing adapter. Fetch app.command_schema before invoking a discovered command. Use domain edit for fills, shapes, source images, groups, typography, layer effects and image controls.
availableToolSchemas.name: app.list_commands

availableToolSchemas.description: Read the authoritative typed arguments and task contract for a commandId from app.list_commands. Layer targets use stable IDs returned by photo.inspect_composition; never invent an ID or pass a UI row index.
availableToolSchemas.name: app.command_schema

availableToolSchemas.description: Invoke a readOnly native command using its discovered commandId and typed values. Rejects every mutable control; this tool requires read capability only. Use the invokeTool returned by app.command_schema.
availableToolSchemas.name: app.inspect_command

availableToolSchemas.description: Invoke an available native command using its exact discovered commandId and typed values. Unavailable or invalid commands fail before mutation. This tool does not grant commit or export capability.
availableToolSchemas.name: app.invoke_command

availableToolSchemas.description: Read the open photo's layers in top-first order, stable ids, selection ids, canvas dimensions, and installed fonts. Call photo.inspect_composition with {assetId}; omit operation and values to receive the authoritative exact family-to-face inventory in fontFaces entries {family,faces}. Choose one exact family and face string from that inventory; do not probe guessed face names to discover styles. With no family/face requested, font availability and fontAxes fields are omitted, not false. If verifying one selected pair, pass values {family,face}; the requested names are echoed without substitution, fontFamilyAvailable/fontFaceAvailable report that exact pair, requestedFamilyFaces lists the selected family's faces, and fontAxes may be empty for an available fixed font.
availableToolSchemas.name: photo.inspect_composition

availableToolSchemas.description: Edit the open photo through the same undoable controls as the user. Read state first using photo.inspect_composition with {assetId}; inspect is not an edit operation. Operations and values: add_text {text,x,y}; add_pixel_layer {} creates an empty editable transparent paint layer and returns createdLayerId; add_source_layer {} creates an editable linked source layer from the open photo and returns createdLayerId, allowing effects to stay editable above the base image; text {text}; typography {family,face,size,weight,italic,underline,color,tracking,lineHeight,strokeWidth,strokeColor,shadowX,shadowY,shadowColor,mode,paragraphSpacing,axes,pathPoints,pathContours,pathStart,pathEnd,pathOffset,pathSpacing,pathSide,pathClosed,pathExclusion,material,materialTint,materialBlur,materialTransmission,materialEdgeSoftness,materialDepth,materialLightAngle}; axes is a map of supported OpenType tags; photo.inspect_composition accepts values {family,face} and returns fontAxes with supported tags and ranges before values are chosen; pathPoints is an ordered list of normalized {x,y} baseline points, with pathStart/pathEnd selecting a path interval, pathOffset moving text to either side, pathSpacing adding tracking in document pixels, and pathSide choosing the contour side, pathContours preserving multiple closed mask outlines including holes, and pathExclusion=true flowing paragraph lines around those contours through the widest free interval. Contour text without exclusion remains single-line. material is none, frosted_glass, smoked_plastic, soft_emboss, polished_chrome, brushed_silver, warm_gold, copper, dark_steel, champagne_gold, rose_gold, antique_brass, titanium, or black_chrome; materialTint sets the material color, materialBlur controls glass backdrop blur, materialTransmission controls glass transparency or metal reflectivity, materialEdgeSoftness and materialDepth shape the bevel, and materialLightAngle moves the studio reflections and edge light. Metal finishes use directional reflection bands and glyph-edge relief so they remain visibly metallic as tint, depth, and light are edited. Glass reads only layers below the text; upper layers remain composited afterward. text_path {maskId,contourIndex?} detaches a traced selection contour into the selected text layer; query the font face's available axes before setting values, and leave axes empty for static fonts; paint {layerId,points,color,size,hardness,opacity,flow,spacing,textureMaterial,textureStrength,textureScale,textureAngle,textureSeed,pressureSize,pressureFlow,clipSelection,lightFalloff,lightExposure,lightTaper,lightAccumulation,tipLayerId,tipPresetName,tipRotationVariation,tipScaleVariation}; points are canvas-pixel {x,y,pressure} samples on an unlocked pixel layer. textureMaterial is solid, dry_ink, graphite, light_paint, or photo_fragment; photo_fragment accepts exactly one of tipLayerId or tipPresetName and uses seeded tipRotationVariation/tipScaleVariation; save_photo_fragment_preset {name,tipLayerId or sourcePresetName,rotationVariation?,scaleVariation?,overwrite?}, import_photo_fragment_preset {path,overwrite?}, export_photo_fragment_preset {name,path}, and delete_photo_fragment_preset {name} manage portable Photo Fragment assets. inspect returns photoFragmentBrushPresets. light_paint adds a soft HDR halo controlled by lightFalloff (0-1), lightExposure (-8 to +8 EV), lightTaper (0-1 at both stroke ends), and lightAccumulation (boolean). For photo_fragment, first create an independent cutout with copy_selection {maskId,independent:true}, inspect to get its pixel-layer ID, then save_photo_fragment_preset with that tipLayerId; paint later with tipPresetName even if the source layer has changed or been removed. The stamp keeps soft alpha and holes. tipRotationVariation is seeded degrees (0-180) and tipScaleVariation is seeded size variance (0-0.9). poll inspect until paintBusy is false and check paintError; transform {x,y,scale,rotation}; perspective {horizontal,vertical}; move {position} (0 is top); copy_selection {maskId,independent?} (omit layerId for the base photo, or provide a content-layer ID to copy that layer through the selection while intersecting its existing mask; independent=true rasterizes the selected content layer and its masks into a self-contained pixel cutout); erase_selection {maskId} (pixel layer required; queues an undoable pixel erase; poll inspect until paintBusy is false and check paintError); select_subject {} (reports an error if segmentation is unavailable); lasso_selection {points,subtract?,feather?} creates a closed editable selection from 3 to 4096 normalized image coordinates, returns createdMaskId, and accepts normalized feather 0-0.05 for soft-edged cutouts; use it to isolate a specific reflection or other detail before copy_selection. blur {sigma}; opacity {opacity}; add_effect {effectType plus type-specific registered effect controls}; update_effect {effectId plus changed controls}; remove_effect {effectId}; reorder_effect {effectId,position} where position is the zero-based effect row within that layer; mask_effect {effectId,maskId} creates an effect mask from an existing selection; clear_effect_mask {effectId}. Effect IDs are returned by add_effect and listed by inspect. These operations use the same undoable layer-effect stack as the editor. Supply only changed typography fields. For text behind a subject: generate or reuse a selection, add and style text, then copy_selection with independent=true and no layerId to place a self-contained cutout above text. Changes apply directly to the open document and support ordinary Undo; they are not agent drafts.

x.description: Normalized image coordinate from zero to one.

y.description: Normalized image coordinate from zero to one.

values.description: Partial text typography update. Distances are canvas pixels; path points are normalized. Inspect available fonts/faces/axes before selecting them.

axes.description: Supported font axis tags mapped to values within the inspected native axis ranges.

layerId.description: Stable existing layer ID at the top level of arguments. Required for operations that edit a layer. Use an inspected ID or a prior creation receipt; never predict a new ID.

position.description: Zero-based integer layer or effect position; zero is top.

rotation.description: Layer rotation in degrees about its center; 0 is unrotated. The editor clamps transform rotation to -3600 through 3600.

scale.description: Uniform layer-size multiplier; 1 is unscaled. The editor clamps transform scale to 0.05 through 32.

size.description: Typography font size in document pixels, not points or screen pixels. Paint size is in canvas pixels. Layer scale multiplies visible size.

x.description: Integer canvas-pixel coordinate, not normalized. add_text places the text origin; transform sets the layer raster's top-left before rotation. Inspect x/y, textOriginX/Y and pixel dimensions after styling.

y.description: Integer canvas-pixel coordinate, not normalized. add_text places the text origin; transform sets the layer raster's top-left before rotation. Inspect x/y, textOriginX/Y and pixel dimensions after styling.

actions.summary: Add headline 'AFTER THE LIGHT' in elegant serif font, large size, warm white, positioned in upper sky.
Add kicker 'SAMPLE / FIELD NOTES 01' in smaller size, aligned with headline, warm white.
Add footer 'A STUDY IN BLUE HOUR' in small size at bottom, aligned left, warm white.

constraints: Preserve existing photo, framing, and color.
Use exactly three editable text layers: Kicker ('SAMPLE / FIELD NOTES 01'), Headline ('AFTER THE LIGHT'), Footer ('A STUDY IN BLUE HOUR').
Strong elegant headline in open sky, consistent left alignment, generous safe margins.
Mountains and lake must remain visible (avoid clipping/obscuring key elements).
Use a real font family and face from inspected list.
plan.outcome: An editorial travel cover design on the existing 1024x1536 image, featuring three distinct text layers with a clear typographic hierarchy (headline > kicker/footer), warm white typography, and careful placement to preserve the landscape's integrity.
plan.summary: Plan to add three text layers to the existing photo. I will inspect the canvas geometry and available fonts first. Then, I will create the headline 'AFTER THE LIGHT' in a large, elegant serif font (e.g., Playfair Display) positioned in the upper open sky area with left alignment. Next, I will add the kicker 'SAMPLE / FIELD NOTES 01' above or near the headline in a smaller sans-serif or lighter weight, and the footer 'A STUDY IN BLUE HOUR' at the bottom, ensuring all text respects safe margins and does not obscure the mountains/lake. The headline will be scaled to be at least 3x larger than the other two.

snapshot.prompt: Create an editorial travel cover on this existing 1024 by 1536 image. Preserve the photograph, framing and color. Use exactly three editable text layers: the small kicker SAMPLE / FIELD NOTES 01, the headline AFTER THE LIGHT, and the footer A STUDY IN BLUE HOUR. Use a strong elegant headline in the open sky, consistent left alignment, generous safe margins, warm white type and clear size hierarchy: the headline must be at least three times the size of both the kicker and footer. Keep the mountains and lake visible. The word SAMPLE must remain legible. Choose a real font family and face from the inspected fontFaces list, and set both explicitly. An empty fontAxes list is valid for a fixed font when fontFamilyAvailable and fontFaceAvailable are true. Deliver the editable composition; do not duplicate text. The active assetId is asset-da4b9a6b972b11a0. Choose the design and tools yourself.
